name: Greater Restoration
description: Touch a creature and end one of: one level of exhaustion, one charm, one petrification, one reduction to an ability score, or a reduction to hit point maximum. One effect only for charmed and petrified. Choosing any option also ends effects marked ends_on_restoration (Geas). Curses and attunement are deferred. Diamond dust is priced and consumed; no item id yet (Tools & Content adds the item). A priced material without an item is unsatisfiable at sim time.

m.text: diamond dust worth at least 100 gp, which the spell consumes
